title: HB1935 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54; Section 36-3-625; Section 38-3-119; Title 39 and Section 40-14-109, relative to restricting access to certain firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-30; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2907757)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-01-30); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing. Caption lists Title 4, Ch. 54, 36-3-625, 38-3-119 and 40-14-109, but the text read contains only SECTION 1 (new section, Title 39) and the effective date.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new section in TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (1) Notwithstanding a law to the contrary, it is an offense for a person to: (A) Purchase or attempt to purchase a weapon of war; or (B) Sell or offer to sell a weapon of war. (2) A violation of this subsection (b) is a Class A misdemeanor.
